lead: Amit Shah is an Indian politician, born on 22 October 1964 in Mumbai.
As of 2026, he is 61 years old, and his birth date places him under the Libra sign.
He has held the office of Member of the Gujarat Legislative Assembly and member of Rajya Sabha.
Below you will find a verified overview of Amit Shah: age, height, birthplace, family background, education, career milestones and awards, each drawn from open public records.

sections.heading: Amit Shah — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Amit Shah was born on 22 October 1964 in Mumbai, and holds Indian nationality. He was given the name Amit Anilchandra Shah at birth and is publicly known as Amit Shah.
His listed education includes Dharmsinh Desai University.

sections.heading: Amit Shah — Career and Professional Work
paras: His professional record lists politician as his main occupation.

He has held the following offices: Member of the Gujarat Legislative Assembly, member of Rajya Sabha (2017–2019), Member of the 17th Lok Sabha, Minister of Home Affairs (2019–present) and Minister of Co-operation (2021–present). He is affiliated with Bharatiya Janata Party.

sections.heading: Amit Shah — Family, Marriage and Personal Life
paras: He is married to Sonal Shah.
He is a parent to Jay Shah.

sections.heading: Amit Shah — Net Worth: What Is Actually Verifiable
paras: Net-worth figures for Amit Shah circulate widely online, but almost none of them come from an audited or officially published source. BioStar does not invent or repeat unsourced numbers, so no dollar figure is stated on this page.
What can be said from the public record is where his income is likely to originate: professional work as a politician, brand partnerships, sponsored social content and public office remuneration.
If a verified figure is published by a credible outlet — a company filing, an election affidavit, or an official disclosure — this section will be updated with the source attached.
